title: Sketchpad React Hooks Rewire
description: Rewire sketchpad react app to use @compose/react ComposeStoreKitLineHost and context hooks; separate clean reads vs operations (mutations/side effects).
summary: Pointed compose/client/lib/react/index.tsx at logic CQRS surface (barrel re-export). Fixed sketchpad tsconfig extends path to ../../js. Documented reads vs operations and ComposeStoreKitLineHost in sketchpad AGENTS. Attempted legacy wasm kit-host split failed: archived render layer requires KitStoreClient APIs removed from @compose/js; deleted render-kit-wasm and reverted sketchpad import experiment. Full sketchpad rewire blocked until wasm registry is reimplemented or call sites migrate to CQRS hooks.
